title: First-secant solve lifecycle and IMS certification diagnostic

source_failure.failure: first SECANT_STO_ITERATION solve returned a finite candidate but MODFLOW did not certify timestep convergence

outputs: candidate head after every MODFLOW solve call
MODFLOW convergence flag and call count
head error to the independent linear oracle
gates: All variants must reach the analytic physical head within 1e-10 m even if a subsystem convergence flag remains false.
NO_WRITE_R1E15 must reproduce the already-qualified HLINK01 unreplaced control.
The diagnostic records rather than retunes any convergence-flag differences.
interpretation: If same-value SY write changes certification, isolate XMI STO mutation lifecycle.
If rclose changes certification at identical head, classify it as IMS certification behavior.
If no variant reproduces HLINK01, compare exact harness lifecycle before changing HLINK02.
forbidden: no production code or solver-setting change
